title: Grilled Slovakian Sausages with Sauerkraut
description: A traditional German-inspired dish featuring Slovakian sausages grilled to perfection and served with tangy sauerkraut.
instructions: Season sausages with paprika and black pepper.
Grill sausages for 5-6 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
Meanwhile, sauté thinly sliced onions and minced garlic in a pan until softened.
Add drained and rinsed sauerkraut to the pan and stir to combine with onions and garlic.
Serve grilled sausages with sauerkraut mixture.
Optional: serve with a side of bread or potatoes.
